name: know-fu
description: A local research library: ingest books, papers and videos, then explain, teach, apply and invent from what it holds.

library_dir.title: Library folder
library_dir.description: The Know Fu library: originals, records and releases. Initialize it first (see the setup guide), and keep it outside this repository and out of sync folders.

state_dir.title: State folder
state_dir.description: Runtime state, including the deletion ledger. Back up its ledgers folder with the library.

media_runtime.title: Media tools
media_runtime.description: Where FFmpeg runs: native (on PATH) or wsl (inside a WSL distribution).

wsl_distro.title: WSL distribution
wsl_distro.description: Only used when media tools run in WSL.

advanced_tools.title: Specialist tools
advanced_tools.description: Also list kb_lifecycle, kb_propose, kb_change, kb_retrieve and kb_evaluate. Leave off for everyday sessions; turn on for purges and maintenance.
